_note: Version 1 of the generation prompt. The production prompt will be versioned the same way (PreviewJob.promptVersion).
replace: Edit the first image, which is a photo of a real room. Replace {target} with this exact product: {product}, in {option}, exactly as shown in the product reference photos. Match the product's shape, proportions, materials, stitching, legs and colour precisely; do not invent details. Scale it realistically for the room and keep it at the same position and angle as the item it replaces. Keep everything else in the room unchanged: walls, floor, windows, lighting, other furniture, objects and camera angle. Match the room's lighting, shadows and perspective so it looks like a real photograph. Do not add text, logos or extra items.
place: Edit the first image, which is a photo of a real room. Place this exact product into the empty floor space: {product}, in {option}, exactly as shown in the product reference photos. Match the product's shape, proportions, materials, stitching, legs and colour precisely; do not invent details. Scale it realistically for the room and set it against the main wall facing the camera. Keep everything else in the room unchanged: walls, floor, windows, lighting, other furniture, objects and camera angle. Match the room's lighting, shadows and perspective so it looks like a real photograph. Do not add text, logos or extra items.
